events.body: The following sections might be updated with supplementary metadata relevant to reviewers and maintainers. ### External sites * Code coverage & benchmarks: https://corecheck.dev/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/36967 * Ralph review https://git.fish.foo/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/36967#author-ralph ### Reviews See [the guideline](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review) and [AI policy](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/doc/AI_POLICY.md) for information on the review process. | Type | Reviewers | | ---- | --------- | | ACK | [stickies-v](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36967#issuecomment-7191106902) | If your review is incorrectly listed, please copy-paste <!--meta-tag:bot-skip--> into the comment that the bot should ignore.

Concept ACK, less review burden when this is automatically checked.

I think in a follow-up we should just bite the bullet and standardize everything to a single `Copyright (c) The Bitcoin Core developers` header, but best to get this in first.
thx, I think it makes sense to automate this boilerplate going forward, instead of spending manual (recurring) review on this.
